lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone adult comedy episode: first snow, a tire shop, a car with four different tires sold by a car flipper. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.

kol.profile: Kolyan — a Russian tire-shop mechanic in his 40s, busy on the first-snow rush day, tired, sarcastic, rough working voice. He swears casually and naturally, like ordinary work talk — not shouting. Adult comedy, uncensored.
kol.notes: Pronounce every swear word fully, clearly and naturally in the flow of speech — never bleep, soften or skip it. Line 1: brisk, busy. Line 2: dry sarcasm. Line 3: listing tires slowly with growing disbelief, then the swear as a resigned sigh. Line 4: deadpan joke. Line 5: flat, unimpressed. Line 6: genuinely amazed, slow.

nas.profile: Nastya — a young Russian woman around 25, first car owner, polite, slightly naive, warm voice.
nas.notes: Line 1: trusting. Line 2: shy, hopeful. Line 3: proud and happy.
